name: Exact Substitution Width for the Six-Cycle
statement: For $C=\{000,001,011,111,110,100\}$ with its middle coordinate substituted and every proper nonempty test $T$, $\sigma(C\circ_iT)=\max\{1,\sigma(T),\sigma(T^{\mathrm c})\}$.
proof: The two outer sections are $\{00,01,10\}$ and $\{01,10,11\}$ with common part $\{01,10\}$; both prescribed section widths are one. The displayed cycle has width one: its cyclic order has width at most one, while shattering all supports of size at most two makes it non-ample and hence excludes width zero. The common-section formula gives the upper bound and recovery of both test sides gives equality.
comments: This is a positive-width isometric example; it is not an ample outer example.
